Droit Facile

Cameroonian law in plain French: topics with the procedures, an assistant that cites its sources, and document drafting.

Visit the site ↗How to useIn motion

01

Problem

Cameroonian law is spread across codes and texts few people read, in a bijural system (civil law and common law). Citizens have no simple starting point, and lawyers answer the same basic questions over and over.

02

What it does

Topics on family, work, housing, business, land and administration, each with the steps, required documents and deadlines. An assistant answers questions from those topics and shows its sources. Rédiger produces letters and simple contracts from a short form. Baobab explains how the legal system is organized.

03

How it is built

React and Postgres. The assistant is limited to the written topics, so every answer can be checked. Paid plans unlock professional tools only; no educational content sits behind a payment. Designed for phones first.

04

In motion

Four frames that summarize the platform. Click to advance.
